question: Should OpenClaw add `agents.list[].tools.web` per-agent overrides, or should per-agent web-search credentials/settings be solved through the broader per-agent plugin configuration contract?
rationale: This would add security-sensitive config surface for credentials, providers, and tool behavior, and automation cannot safely choose the durable precedence and ownership model.

options.title: Design agent-scoped web/tool settings
options.body: Add `agents.list[].tools.web` with explicit merge precedence, SecretRef/redaction semantics, provider ownership rules, docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Fold credentials into plugin config
options.body: Keep web-search provider credentials under a generic per-agent plugin config contract and leave only non-credential web tool policy here.

options.title: Defer core config expansion
options.body: Keep this unsupported until multi-agent isolation is solved by separate gateways or another broader isolation primitive.

recommendation.title: Design agent-scoped web/tool settings
recommendation.body: Add `agents.list[].tools.web` with explicit merge precedence, SecretRef/redaction semantics, provider ownership rules, docs, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a product/security config-boundary decision, and recent plugin/config helper history plus security-sensitive CODEOWNERS context point most strongly to this owner.
